result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: on expiry or termination, Vendor must provide requested transition and migration assistance for up to six months at then-current rates; Customer Data must be returned within 30 days of request in a suitable machine-readable format; and remaining data must thereafter be securely deleted with written officer certification, subject to lawful retention. The revision appropriately replaces only the conflicting immediate cut-off and deletion language, preserves the existing data-return and deletion protections, and is professionally drafted. The margin comment accurately describes the change and fallback.
